scientific_integrity: Finite claims certified by exhaustive face enumeration with two algorithms, exact GF2 boundary ranks from row and column elimination, and checked chain identities. No independence claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite F2-homology of two seven-vertex tournaments and n<=6 threshold; no integral torsion or homotopy classification; incomplete bibliographic coverage possible.
title: Equal face numbers and unequal multipath homology after a two-step tournament reversal
